verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into a full Grit bar and eat a charged W into E-flip before level 6; you win if you poke with outer-edge Q and punish his long W cooldown to stack five bleeds before he can shield through it.

brief.thesis: Darius's auto-attack range and Q (Decimate) outer-edge poke outrange Sett's only gap closer, E (Facebreaker), which has short grab range and a visible travel animation. As long as you stay outside E range and bait W (Haymaker) before committing, you dictate the trade tempo through level 5 — but a landed E-flip while his Grit bar is full lets him shield through your punish and combo into Q (Knuckle Down) empowered strikes.

tell.watch: Sett's Grit bar under his HP

theirWindow.when: Grit bar full and E off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He's looking to flip you with E into empowered Q punches behind a free shield. Don't stand and trade autos here — back off and let the shield expire before re-engaging.

yourWindow.when: W (Haymaker) just whiffed or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and stack Hemorrhage with Q outer edge, autos, and W (Crippling Strike). W is his only real disengage or all-in tool early, so punishing its ~14s cooldown lets you hit 5 stacks and threaten R before he resets Grit.

powerCurve.note: Q poke range beats his zero-range kit
E grab online, but still whiffable
Black Cleaver shred wins extended duels
Both strong duelists, he's harder to kite

start.why: Sustain and damage reward autoattack trading against Sett's short engage range without needing to commit to an all-in.

boots.why: Reduces damage from his empowered Q punches and the physical burst on E-R combos.

core.why: Spellblade proc adds burst the moment you land E (Apprehend), and the move speed helps you stick on him after he whiffs W.
Armor shred stacks cut through any tank items he buys to survive your bleed stacking, and the HP helps you survive his flip-burst.
Converts his E-R burst into damage over time, which your Hemorrhage passive then heals back.

situational.when: if he's building crit or lethality to burst you down in one flip
if the enemy jungler or mid adds hard CC on top of his E stun
if he's snowballing and diving you repeatedly with jungle help
if their team shifts to a magic-damage-heavy comp around him

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades and skirmishes are where you win this lane, and the adaptive force plus healing lets you outlast his burst windows.

summoners.why: Ghost lets you close the gap the instant his W is on cooldown and helps you kite, since outside of E and R he has no hard engage or escape.

playing.title: Poke with Q outer edge
playing.detail: Stand at max range and hit only the outer blade of Decimate to stack Hemorrhage without walking into his E grab range.

playing.title: Respect the W charge glow
playing.detail: When he holds Haymaker, his fist glows and he's rooted in place. Walk out of the cone; a whiffed charge is your signal to all-in since the cooldown is long early.

playing.title: Count his Grit bar
playing.detail: The bar under his HP fills from damage dealt and taken. Don't commit E into R until it's empty, or he shields through your burst.

playing.title: Punish E whiffs hard
playing.detail: Facebreaker has a short range and a clear travel telegraph. If it misses, that's your all-in window since he has no other gap closer until 6.

playing.title: Bank 5 stacks before R
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine scales with Hemorrhage stacks, so land W and autos to hit 5 stacks before going for the execute so the threshold is actually lethal.

playing.title: Never facetank a charged R
playing.detail: At level 6+, The Show Stopper slams for a percent of your max HP and can be thrown over terrain. Don't sit low enough that it one-shots you through minions.

playing.title: Pull, don't chase, his all-in
playing.detail: Apprehend's pull slightly outranges his E. If he goes for the flip, pull him out of position first to cancel his combo and start yours instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build and rune names reflect Darius's standard kit and itemization as I know it (Trinity Force into Black Cleaver and Death's Dance, Conqueror keystone); verify against the actual patch 16.18.1 notes since item availability and keystone tuning may have shifted since my training cutoff.
